title: Resolving Disputes Arising from Conflicts between Terms in Lasting Power of Attorney Drawn Up in Singapore and Overseas
what_it_is: Resolving Disputes Arising from Conflicts between Terms in Lasting Power of Attorney Drawn Up in Singapore and Overseas

sections.label: Foreign LPA conflicts
sections.summary: Minister says legislation does not require certificate issuers to check for foreign instruments, but the suggestion will be considered at the next review.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Social and Family Development in view of the potential conflicts and legal disputes that may arise between a Singapore Lasting Power of Attorney (LPA) and an equivalent instrument executed in a foreign jurisdiction (a) whether the current legislation requires an LPA certificate issuer to enquire if a donor has previously executed a LPA or a similar instrument in a foreign jurisdiction; and (b) if not, whether such a requirement can be considered as part of the legislation.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: We do not expect such scenarios to be common and are mindful to keep the LPA application process simple.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Nevertheless, we note the suggestion raised by the Member and will take it into consideration when the legislation is next reviewed.

sections.label: LPA certificate issuer safeguards
sections.summary: The speaker says certificate issuers play a major role as safeguards and agrees their role is not merely to rubber-stamp applications.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: I think the LPA certificate issuers play a major role in terms of safeguards to ensure that LPAs are effective and not being used as a tools of court litigation going forward as well.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: I fully agree with the Member that the role of the LPA Certificate Issuer is not merely to rubber-stamp the LPA application.

sections.label: Who can be certificate issuer
sections.summary: A certificate issuer must be a Public Guardian-accredited medical practitioner, a practising lawyer, or a registered psychiatrist.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: You have to be a medical practitioner that is accredited by the Public Guardian, or you have to be a practising lawyer or you have to be a registered psychiatrist.

sections.label: Certificate issuer meets donor
sections.summary: The certificate issuer must meet the donor in person to check sound mind, understanding of the LPA, and absence of fraud or undue pressure.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: First of all, the CI has to meet the donor in person.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: We have required this as a safeguard because the CI needs to play a few roles and one of which is to make sure that the donor is of sound mind, understands the intent and the scope of the LPA, and at the same time, verify that the donor is not induced by fraud or is under any undue pressure to make the LPA.

sections.label: Certificate issuer record keeping
sections.summary: The certificate issuer must keep clear detailed records of steps taken to ascertain the donor's mental capacity, and guides given to issuers may be beefed up.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: For this entire process, the CI must keep clear and detailed records of the steps that had been taken in order for him to ascertain the mental capacity of the donor and how he has arrived at this conclusion that the donor has mental capacity.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: These are guides that have been given to the CIs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: But we take the Member's suggestions that we can perhaps beef up the guide that is currently being provided.
